channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Devonte Graham | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Devonte Graham from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Devonte Graham
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:Pop on Devonte' Graham:

“Devonte is a very good shooter, very veteran-like, spent four years at Kansas. He has been a wonderful member of the team there in New Orleans. Class guy. Happy to have him.”

Gregg Popovich on Devonte Graham, Feb 10, 2023. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Devonte Graham
item.description:
Coach Pop on Devonte’ Graham:

“Devonte’ is a very good shooter and veteran. He spent four years in Kansas. He’s been a wonderful member of their team in New Orleans, class act guy, I’m happy to have him.”

Gregg Popovich on Devonte Graham, Feb 10, 2023. Source: Twitter @PaulGarciaNBA.

item.title: James Borrego on Devonte Graham
item.description:
Rod Boone:James Borrego on #Hornets approach with Devonte's groin injury:

“We'll be cautious with this one. (What happens) after tonight I can't speak to that. But he’s getting better. He's progressing. I just want to make sure he's 100 percent.”

James Borrego on Devonte Graham, Feb 10, 2021. Source: Twitter @rodboone.

item.title: Terry Rozier on Devonte Graham
item.description:
Rick Bonnell:Terry Rozier on Devonte Graham:

“I don’t think he’s worried about the outside noise... He knows we’ve got his back.”

Terry Rozier on Devonte Graham, Jan 19, 2021. Source: Twitter @rick_bonnell.

item.title: Kenny Atkinson on Devonte Graham
item.description:
Nets coachKenny Atkinson on @Devonte Graham’s 3-point shooting:

“We’d better get him into the 2-point area, where he’s a little more uncomfortable.”

Kenny Atkinson on Devonte Graham, Dec 6, 2019. Source: Twitter @rick_bonnell.
